releaseNotes: Fifteen issue codes were malformed and nobody had noticed, because four gates carried their own copy of missingPhraseCode. The shared helper in scripts/lib/launch-state.ts collapses every non-alphanumeric run to a single underscore; the four local copies replaced spaces only. So a required phrase like "ParthJadhav/app-store-screenshots" produced store_screenshots.parthjadhav/app-store-screenshots.missing — a path separator inside an issue code — and "DESIGN.md" produced store_screenshots.design.md.missing, which has four segments where the contract is prefix.name.missing. This is the escapeHtml lesson repeating one release later: the copies were not identical, and the divergence showed up in the one surface roughly 700 fixtures assert against.

All four gates now import the shared helper, and the fifteen codes are well-formed. Two of them were pinned by fixtures and both were updated. One consequence is recorded rather than papered over: check-store-screenshots requires both "App Preview Video" (the section a reader looks for) and "app-preview-video" (the asset-name convention the pipeline writes), and both slugify to store_screenshots.app_preview_video.missing. That is the only colliding pair in the list, the issue message still names which phrase is absent, and a comment sits next to the pair so the collision is visible rather than discovered.

Two fixtures pin the code shape so a re-added local slugifier fails loudly. One asserts a phrase carrying a dot, the other a phrase carrying a slash — the case a space-only replacement can never produce. Without them, deleting the local copies would be a change nothing could detect.

Five byte-identical helper copies are gone. isRecord had three local redefinitions (check-archetype-starter, check-package-parity, check-continuity-contract), founder-gate-presentation redefined both isRecord and asArray, and founder-operator.fixtures.ts carried the same function under the name isRecordValue. All six bodies were character-for-character the export in launch-state.ts.

Three declarations kept a shared name while meaning something else, which is worse than duplication because it reads as agreement. check-continuity-contract's asString also rejected whitespace-only values, so a continuity field set to " " failed there and passed everywhere else; it is now asNonEmptyString with a comment saying why it is not the shared one. check-compound-engineering-routing's statusValues is the CE routing vocabulary, not the lane statuses of the same name, and is now ceRoutingStatusValues. render-design-room's local panelCopy function shadowed founder-copy's exported panelCopy map and is now founderPanelCopy.

The twelve local skillRoot constants were deliberately left alone. A blanket "no local name may shadow a scripts/lib export" gate was measured before being rejected: twenty-two matches, twelve of them skillRoot, which every script legitimately resolves from its own import.meta.url rather than importing from the design-state module. A rule that needs an allowlist for most of its hits is not a rule, so this release ships the cleanup without one and records the measurement instead of the gate.
